name: esg-commitment-audit
description: Audit ESG and climate commitments with source-linked evidence through the ICS hosted API.

interface.shortDescription: Audit ESG commitments with traceable policy evidence
interface.longDescription: Find written ESG and climate commitments, trace each finding to page or paragraph evidence, and test observability, enforceability, and revisability. The plugin is free; hosted audits require a matching ESG API key.
defaultPrompt: Use $esg-commitment-audit to audit this ESG report and show traceable commitment gaps.
